title: Workflow Studio
description: CAT 100 textbook section connecting workflow studio to published workflow site with revision trace, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.

learning_objectives.statement: Name the homepage index.html so the site resolves at its root instead of returning a 404
Use relative image paths so images load for every visitor, not just on your computer
Enable publishing in the host's settings, since pushing files alone does not make a site live
Close every HTML tag so the browser renders the content as intended

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
